questions.question: Lanette Pienaar set a database record (14/15 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 153. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Individual Score', held by Lanette Pienaar.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Micaela Andrews holds it with 26, a joint record shared with Jané Winster.

questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval — largest win by runs of 262, against Kei on 2015/02/21.

questions.question: At which ground did M Motshabi record their career-best bowling figures (4-26, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2019/01/19.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Iinyathi or Badgers?
Nonkululeko Mlaba took a Test five-wicket haul in South Africa's most recent Test, played in December 2024. Who were the opponents?
questions.explanation: Mlaba took 6 for 67 against England at Mangaung Oval, Bloemfontein, South Africa's only Test since 2007.
